## About
We're a small shop in St Louis Park doing collision repair, refinishing and hail repair. When you come in, you'll usually be talking with Mike, and he'll tell you straight what your car needs.
One customer called us that special mom-and-pop shop you want to find. We'll take that. We've earned a 5 rating from 97 Google reviews, one neighbor at a time.

## Services
- Collision repair and refinishing: Body work and paint after a run-in. One customer brought in a nasty mark on his BMW, and the scratch came out completely gone.
- Hail repair: Repair for hail damage on your car.
